result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: the bottom restaurant card is clipped behind the tab bar, and the top-right profile button appears empty.

issues.description: The second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off and slides under the bottom tab bar, hiding the restaurant name, delivery info and lower part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so list content scrolls fully above the fixed Home/Search/Orders/Profile bar

issues.description: Top-right circular button appears as an empty light-grey placeholder with only a small red dot, with no avatar, icon or initial loaded inside.
issues.suggestion: Load the user profile image or a default profile/account icon inside the circular button
